# Will your migration redirect map break your search traffic?

> Free 301 redirect map checker for site migrations: finds redirect loops, chains, conflicting duplicates, mass redirects to the homepage, spaces and fragments in URLs, targets missing from the new site and old URLs with no rule, then writes a flattened map for Shopify, Netlify, Apache or nginx.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
